name: Brand filter hides products from other brands

steps.snapshotHint: Look for a filter button or .filter-fab button

steps.description: Click a brand filter chip/checkbox in the filter panel
steps.snapshotHint: Look for brand names in the filter sidebar — .filters section

steps.script: (() => { const brands = document.querySelectorAll('.card-brand'); const uniqueBrands = new Set(); brands.forEach(b => uniqueBrands.add(b.textContent.trim())); return { count: uniqueBrands.size, brands: [...uniqueBrands] }; })()
steps.description: After filtering, all visible cards should be the selected brand

businessContext: Brand filter is essential for customers comparing specific brands like Apple or Samsung
